author: evac
description: Role-holder daily photo-drop job: daily quota submissions, a streak, a strike system that controls a job role, PTO, an automatic weekly Photo of the Week poll, and a nightly owner rating pass (GOAT/Good/Mid/Bad) on every photo. The job role is the single source of truth for who can drop.
install_msg: Thanks for installing photodrop! Commands live under `.pp` or `.pockypolice`. The job role defaults to a hardcoded ID -- confirm it with `.pp set role @role`, then set `.pp set channel #channel` before anyone drops photos. `.pp hire @user` adds the role to get someone started. Rating buttons default to the server owner -- change that with `.pp set rater @user`. Browse rated photos with `.pp rated goat|good|mid|bad`.
short: Daily photo-drop job with a streak, a strike system, PTO, a weekly photo poll, and owner photo ratings.
